connector.name: Ai Optimizer
connector.registryDescription: MCP server that cuts AI coding agent token usage via framework-aware context optimization
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package core. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the shivam-app-developers account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AI_OPTIMIZER_LICENSE
env.description: Ed25519 JWT license key. Unlocks Pro/Team packs; free tier needs no key.

env.name: AI_OPTIMIZER_LSP
env.description: Set to 0 to disable the LSP bridge (optimized_diagnostics).

env.name: AI_OPTIMIZER_TELEMETRY
env.description: Set to 'on' to enable anonymous opt-in telemetry. Off by default.
